title: Masked Input Behavior
description: Formats input against a mask pattern (9 = digit, A = letter) as the user types.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the empty field. When set it replaces the placeholder derived from the mask.

maskPlaceholder.description: Character that stands for each unfilled slot when the placeholder is derived from the mask (`999-99-9999` shows `___-__-____`). Used only when the element has no `placeholder` of its own.

wbBehavior.name: masked
wbBehavior.description: Applies input masking to text fields.
